Discover your dream team.

Tech & Product

Business is the greatest platform for change.

At Salesforce, we believe business is a powerful platform for creating meaningful, positive change in the world. We're not just building products; we’re building a better future, one where innovation and values go together. Here’s what this means:

Innovation that multiplies

Innovation matters most when people can put it to work. We build technology that transforms businesses around the world, helping our customers connect more closely with their customers. What starts with a single solution can ripple into the everyday experiences of millions of people.

Learn more

Our values drive value

At Salesforce, we believe in doing well and doing good. Our values of Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, Equality, and Sustainability are part of how we do business and guide the decisions we make every day.

Learn more

Giving back is built in

Our 1-1-1 model puts Salesforce technology and resources to work for nonprofits and communities. We also support employees in giving their time and skills to causes that matter to them.

Learn more

Investing in a better future

A better future isn’t only about what we build, but about creating opportunities for the people who will live in it. That’s why we support education, workforce development, sustainability, and other efforts that help people and communities move forward.

Frequently Asked Questions

Salesforce hires people across technology and product, sales, customer success, corporate functions, and early career programs. Roles at Salesforce range from software engineers, AI researchers, product managementers, and designers to account executives, solution engineers, and customer success managers. We also hire within the finance, legal, marketing, Employee Success (HR) departments, and more.

Explore our teams and search open Salesforce jobs, or join our Talent Community to stay connected.

No. The experience you need to work at Salesforce depends on the role. Technical expertise is important for roles like software engineering, machine learning, data science, architecture, and some solution engineering positions, but many roles at Salesforce don’t require a technical background or Salesforce platform experience.

AI is deeply integrated into how we work, so AI fluency is increasingly important across Salesforce. You don’t need a professional background in AI, but you should be curious about what’s possible and ready to keep learning.

If you want to build your AI or Salesforce skills before applying, Trailhead, Salesforce’s free online learning platform, offers self-paced learning on AI, Agentforce, Salesforce products, and more.

The skills Salesforce looks for vary by role, but we value a mix of expertise in your field and qualities that help people succeed in a fast-changing, AI-powered workplace. These include collaboration, adaptability, sound judgment, evidence-based decision-making, and the ability to work effectively across teams.

How you work matters, too. Our values of trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability guide how we show up for each other, our customers, and our communities.

Learn more about how we hire, and review the qualifications listed in each job description to see the technical, functional, and role-specific skills required for that position.

Salesforce is a collaborative, values-driven workplace built around customer success, innovation, learning, and giving back. Employees work across global teams, use Salesforce products, Agentforce, and Slackbot in their own workflows, and continue to grow as roles and technology evolve.

Community is also an important part of the Salesforce employee experience. We invest in employee growth through ongoing upskilling and internal mobility, foster belonging through 16 employee-led Equality Groups, and empower our people to give their time and skills to causes they care about through our 1-1-1 model.

Explore the Salesforce Careers blog for stories from employees about their teams, careers, and experiences at Salesforce.

Yes. Salesforce offers internships, new graduate roles, and opportunities for advanced-degree candidates through Futureforce, our university recruiting program. These programs span areas such as technology and product, sales, customer success, AI research, and corporate functions, with availability varying by role and location.

Early career candidates interested in AI can also explore programs such as the Builders program, where participants build with AI from the start. 

Program dates and eligibility vary, so check current program details for the latest information.

Salesforce has offices and hires globally, with its headquarters at Salesforce Tower in San Francisco and regional headquarters in Dublin for EMEA and Sydney for APAC.

Major Salesforce hubs also include New York, Indianapolis, Chicago, Atlanta, and Seattle in the U.S.; London, Munich, and Amsterdam in Europe; Tokyo and Singapore in Asia; Hyderabad and Bengaluru (Bangalore) in India; and Mexico City and São Paulo in Latin America, among others. Salesforce has offices in more than 30 countries.

Hiring locations vary by role and team. Explore open jobs to see where we’re currently hiring.

Most Salesforce roles are office-based or office-flex (hybrid), with regular in-person time helping teams connect, collaborate, and build together. Office-based employees typically work in the office four to five days per week, while office-flex employees typically work in person three days per week. Some engineering teams follow a different schedule, coming together in person 10 days per quarter, often timed around key product releases. Select positions are designated remote.

Work arrangements vary by team and position, so check the job description for the workplace expectations of a specific role.

Yes. Salesforce offers relocation assistance for some eligible roles when a move is required for the position. Eligibility and the type of support available vary by role and location. Check the job description or ask your recruiter whether relocation assistance is available for the position you're considering.

Equal Opportunity Statement.

At Salesforce we believe that the business of business is to improve the state of our world. Each of us has a responsibility to drive Equality in our communities and workplaces. We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more. Learn more about Equality at www.equality.com and explore our company benefits at www.salesforcebenefits.com.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal . Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

Salesforce welcomes all.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com .
